notes.title: It plays great on Deck
notes.notes:
First update after release! ːsteamhappyː

Things added today:
[list]
[*] Keyboard and Gamepad Support
[*] Spanish Language
[/list]

[h3]Keyboard and Gamepad Support[/h3]
It was already working thanks to Steam Deck's touchscreen but we now make it official. When playing on the Deck you can use the either the analog controls or the buttons to control de rabbits, a hint with the buttons actions will appear at the bottom of the screen. The same when connecting a gamepad or keyboard, no matter the model! Currently generic hints and prompts will be shown, but the basic functions are working top notch and are enough to fully enjoy the game. Just press a button and you are ready to slide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45154282/7f8ca99437ad1a6b0d39d7707ae22a67cc2df918.jpg[/img]

[h3]Spanish Language - Idioma Español[/h3]
The game has pretty few text, but we are native Spanish speakers, its a minor quality of life update to have the texts in Spanish. Also this opens the door to have more languages in the future.

Hey! If you read until here, thank you!
Hope you are enjoying the game!
